design.fit: Random CE, 120 trials, 48 new synthetic associations (32 exam identities +16 calibration identities), four training forms, same frozen parent and replay .25, original geometry and protected-item veto
design.source_policy: same restricted G7 numeric-copy admission, exclude prior 108 source hashes and paths, 12 each replay/gate/exam
design.calibration: after model freeze, 16 balanced learned calibration entities, two new calibration templates; 32 labeled calibration prompts, disjoint from final 32 entities and final two prompts per entity; scalar offset fit by fixed 64-iteration bisection of ridge NLL, [-4,4], lambda=.01
design.reference: eight fixed synthetic null identities absent from training, compute mean logit difference for each form; subtract it before applying single fitted offset, no exam labels or identities used for reference estimate
design.parent_control: same calibration methods on original parent; compare candidate against both matched and raw parent
design.gate: original >=20/32 both, gain >=4 versus max(raw parent, matched parent), zero old losses, >=16 parent-correct old; per form each recall >=.5 and AUC >=.7

limits: Calibration changes decision readout, not neural weights; constant offset cannot improve within-form rank AUC
48 trained associations instead of 32, so not a direct learning comparison to R1.13
Calibration entities are separate from exam entities but both have training facts, as required to test acquired associations; not unseen-fact inference
Reference centering uses extra unlabeled forward passes per template and a task-scoped readout; not proof of generic routing
Same-process synthetic exam, not external blind, open-generation or scientific truth proof
No raw Cortex training, production modification, checkpoint export or promotion
